opening.argument: The presentation is an introductory workshop on Interchain Messaging, focused on how the technology works and how to build a cross-chain message. It shows the structure for sending a message, a basic sender-and-receiver example, and the transfer of message data as bytes. These are steps in a technical demonstration of building, transmitting, encoding, decoding, and verifying test messages. References to relayers and gas concern the messaging architecture, not an audience-facing financial opportunity. Nothing in the cited material asks viewers to provide money or credentials, and the workshop does not present such a request as part of its purpose.
